# Does direct CasADi differentiation of J(q) multiplied by qdot, already validated in original thread, constitute a reliable Jdot scheme?

> **Current answer:** No. The 2026 comment calculates the Frame Jacobian, flattens it, and computes ca.jacobian(J_flat, q) @ qdot, then reorders it as 6×nv. This is only the method the commenter shared. No comparison with simulation results, Pinocchio fixed version, or other reference frames is provided, and no maintainer has confirmed it, so it can only be considered as a pending experimental scheme.
